maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Crash recovery, database check, local logs and their export. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

updates.name: Updates
updates.description: Checks for a new signed version when you ask (or at start, if you turn that on) and installs it only after you confirm.

log_level.label: Log detail
log_level.description: How much the app writes to its local log file.

log_max_kb.label: Log file size (KiB)
log_max_kb.description: The log starts a new file at this size.

log_files.label: Old log files kept
log_files.description: How many older log files are kept before the oldest is deleted.

check_after_crash.label: Check the database after a crash
check_after_crash.description: When the app did not close normally, check the collection for damage at the next start.

check_on_start.label: Check for updates at start
check_on_start.description: Off by default: the app contacts the update server only when you ask.

logs.heading: Logs
logs.intro: The app keeps a local log. Export it to attach to a bug report: keys, tokens and passwords are removed first. Nothing is sent automatically.
logs.exported: Saved {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to {path}. {redactions, plural, one {# secret} other {# secrets}} removed.
logs.save_prompt: Where should the log bundle be saved?
logs.bundle: Log bundle for a bug report

integrity.heading: Database
integrity.problems: Problems found: {count}. Choose a rescue below.

crashes.heading: Crash reports
crashes.cleared: {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}} deleted.

previous_run.unclean: The last run did not close normally.

recovery.intro: Your collection is saved after every change. Here is what can be picked up again:
recovery.integrity_bad: The database check found problems. Open Maintenance for details.
recovery.drafts: {count, plural, one {# unsaved form} other {# unsaved forms}}, restored when you open them again

updates.heading: Updates
updates.unsupported: This build cannot update itself (development build).
updates.ready: Downloaded and verified. The app will close, install and start again.

rescue.label: Rescue
rescue.intro: The collection is damaged. Choose how to rescue it: nothing is deleted, the damaged files are moved to the damaged folder and kept.
rescue.confirm_backup: The app restarts and puts the newest backup that verifies in place of the collection. Changes made after that backup are only in the kept damaged files.
rescue.confirm_readable: The app restarts and copies every row that can still be read into a new collection. What cannot be read is only in the kept damaged files.
rescue.done_backup: The collection was restored from the newest verified backup. The damaged files are kept here:
rescue.done_readable: The readable part of the collection was rescued. The damaged files are kept here:
rescue.failed: The rescue did not work, nothing was changed.

maintenance.subtitle: Trash, duplicates and a health check of your collection.
maintenance.trash_desc: Deleted decks and notes wait here until you restore them or empty the trash.
maintenance.duplicates_desc: Notes whose first field is the same
maintenance.check_desc: Looks for broken links between cards, notes and decks, and repairs them on request.
maintenance.duplicates_intro: Find notes you added twice and tidy them up in Search.
